about_the_game:
Immerse yourself in a nightmare world where every step is a battle against fears in a world full of puzzles and challenges to become a dream keeper.

About the game

A hero whose soul is scarred by past traumas awakens in a dark world where the only guide is the glow of the Arrow of Hope. Forestless is an atmospheric adventure game with many puzzles, some of them procedurally generated and always different, battles with your fears and overcoming obstacles through platforms.

The world itself is a collective realm of fears, not just the hero's mind. He faces both the physical manifestations of his fears and the souls of those who have lost their battles.

Gameplay

Light lamps to maintain stamina, quickly overcome all obstacles and defeat enemies.

Solve puzzles to light lamps that are procedurally generated and anywhere, and with rotating mechanisms that revisit traumatic memories and change the hero's perspective on the past.

Collect items of power to complete challenges in confusing mazes, avoid laser guards, and reach the boss of each biome to battle the Reaper himself at the end.

Also meet and help souls who have similar fears to yours and accept a challenge from them to help you deal with yours.

Will you be able to guide the hero through this nightmare world and bring him back to peace, or will fear consume another soul?

short_description: Forestless is an atmospheric psychological adventure where you'll journey through a world of fears armed only with a magical arrow of hope. Explore biomes that embody human nightmares - from misty wastelands of loneliness to scorched deserts of loss.
supported_languages: English, French, Italian, German, Spanish - Spain, Portuguese - Brazil, Greek, Traditional Chinese, Simplified Chinese, Korean, Dutch, Norwegian, Polish, Russian, Turkish, Finnish, Czech, Swedish, Japanese, Malay
